question: 9,044 (plan/authority docs) vs 9,040 (66.1 coverage scan) legacy M5 not_modelable swaps
answer: Both are correct for different commits. 9,044 = 25,933 swaps - 16,889 paired tests at Bot cycle 61 (fcbce1e) and still 9,044 at 62.3 (bd4b5af, 25,940 swaps). The cycle 63.2 regeneration on snap-20261016 (42157ff) moved 11 swaps out of and 7 into the not_modelable set (net -4) across 12 decks; the stored files (and every later commit) hold 9,040 = 25,940 - 16,900. The docs quoted the cycle-61 figure.
method: per-swap diff of swaps with an empty tests list between git revisions (swap ids are hashes of list hash|cut|add)
